result.reason: The new Section 20 reaches the preferred position: Vendor defends and indemnifies Customer and its Affiliates against third-party IP, legal-compliance, Vendor-caused data-breach, and gross-negligence/wilful-misconduct claims; Customer's indemnity is confined to Customer-provided content and breach of law; and customary notice, control, cooperation, IP exclusions, and infringement remedies are included. The insertion also cures the existing Section 20.5 cross-reference without altering unrelated provisions. No 3× cap is required because that is only the fallback position.
